narrative.summary: An automatically built and tested assistant was developed, achieving a baseline training pass rate of 88% and maintaining the same score after optimization. The assistant performed on a holdout set, achieving a pass rate of 75% across 4 cases. Overall, the assistant demonstrated consistent performance in training but showed some limitations in real-world scenarios.
narrative.limitations: The assistant has 3 known failures and faced challenges with unsupported asks, indicating areas for improvement. Additionally, the evaluation set was small, consisting of only 4 holdout cases, which may limit the generalizability of the results.
